# Ana María Palacios | Travel Insurance

> Ana María Palacios is a bilingual (English and Spanish) travel insurance agent who works with Best Travel Assistance. She prepares personalized travel insurance quotes and supports clients one on one by WhatsApp before, during, and after their trip.

## About
- Name: Ana María Palacios
- Role: Travel insurance agent working with Best Travel Assistance
- Languages: English and Español
- Coverage types (depending on the plan): emergency medical care, trip cancellation and interruption, travel delays, lost or delayed baggage. Each plan has its own benefits, limits, and exclusions.
- Cost: quotes and guidance are free with no obligation
- Contact: you talk to Ana directly, not a call center

## How to get a quote
1. Send your trip details (number of travelers and their ages, where you are going, and your country of residence) using the quote form or WhatsApp.
2. Ana reviews your trip and sends plan options and prices.
3. If you choose a plan, Ana helps you complete the purchase before you travel.
